messages:
incident-bot: SEV alert: sustained increase in inference errors and backlog in ap-southeast cluster. Affected: /v1/embeddings (queue growth + 5xx), /v1/rerank (timeouts). Paging oncall.
erin: oncall here 44d. seeing batch jobs consuming huge token budgets. KV cache thrash + long GC cycles.
khalid: looking at node allocation 50d. GPUs healthy but processes stuck in GC waiting for big tensors to free.
natasha: customer impact? are chat customers hit?
erin: chat (interactive) mostly OK, but long-context chat requests and background embeddings jobs are compounding. Prefer targeted route limits over global shutdown.
oliver: agree. propose: 1) emergency per-endpoint throttle for embeddings only 2) per-plan caps (enterprise vs standard) 3) route-specific concurrency for rerank 4) enable token-shave transform for >256k tokens to reject/trim.
erin: executing soft throttle for embeddings across ap-southeast first:
```
redwoodctl rate-limit set --route /v1/embeddings --scope region:ap-southeast --limit 45qps --burst 90 --type soft --note "emergency: reduce batch storm"
```
deploy-bot: rate-limit applied -> /v1/embeddings ap-southeast: 45qps (soft).
erin: immediate effect: incoming embedding requests down ~48% in 70s, backlog dropping.
khalid: next, per-plan caps. We want enterprise jobs to retain some throughput; throttle standard plans harder. Commands:
```
redwoodctl quota patch --plan standard --route /v1/embeddings --max_tokens_per_min 30000 --reason "emergency per-plan cap"
redwoodctl quota patch --plan enterprise --route /v1/embeddings --max_tokens_per_min 120000 --reason "emergency per-plan cap"
```
infra-bot: quotas updated for plans standard, enterprise.
natasha: rerank still timing out on complex queries. Lower concurrency and fallback to emb-rerank-lite model for time-boxed requests.
erin: doing rerank changes now:
```
redwoodctl route update --path /v1/rerank --concurrency 3 --fallback_model rerank-lite-v1 --region ap-southeast
```
deploy-bot: route update applied (canary 15%).
oliver: also enabling a token-shaving middleware that either truncates excessive contexts or asks callers to split requests. Toggle:
```
redwoodctl feature toggle --feature token-shave --route /v1/* --threshold_tokens 262144 --action truncate
```
deploy-bot: token-shave enabled globally (threshold 262144). First 5 minutes: ~0.6% requests truncated.
support-bot: notifying CSMs & top-10 volume tenants about degraded embedding throughput and rerank latency. Template drafted.
erin: additional mitigation: divert lower-priority embeddings traffic to backup cluster in eu-west where spare capacity exists. This keeps chat local and interactive.
khalid: routing rule applied:
```
redwoodctl route traffic-split --route /v1/embeddings --primary ap-southeast --secondary eu-west --weight 0.7:0.3 --policy priority:interactive
```
deploy-bot: traffic split in effect. Initial effect: eu-west receiving ~28% of embedding requests.
oliver: we should avoid throttling chat; set chat route to high-priority queue and limit long-seq chat to 4 concurrent per-key.
erin: applying chat caps for long seqs:
```
redwoodctl quota patch --route /v1/chat --condition "seq_len>4096" --max_concurrency_per_key 4
```
deploy-bot: chat long-seq concurrency limit applied.
natasha: quick check on customer-visible errors: support reports 3 timeouts from two customers. We have started outreach.
support-bot: messages sent to affected customers, included remediation steps and opt-in reserved throughput windows.
khalid: metrics: backlog reduced to 1.2x baseline in 10m, embeddings p95 latency down from 1.2s -> 340ms, rerank p95 improved to 420ms.
erin: plan for rollback: wait 30m of stable metrics (queue depth <1.1x, errors <1.5%) then relax plan caps by 25% every 10m. If spike recurs, reapply.
oliver: permanent actions to add to postmortem: auto-detection rule for per-key token surge (>3x baseline for 5m) triggers automatic per-key quarantine + notify. Also add per-route emergency weight limits to allow traffic diversion to spare regions automatically.
natasha: capturing timeline in INC-3302. Adding owners for follow-ups: infra: @khalid, ops: @erin, product: @oliver.
incident-bot: RUNBOOK: If backlog grows >1.5x after rollback attempt, escalate to SRE-oncall.
erin: handoff in 40m; I'll stay until metrics stable then hand to khalid for follow-up.
support-bot: ticket INC-3302 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-3302. All customer comms logged.
khalid: quick note: we enabled `rerank-lite-v1` fallback for timeboxed requests which reduces quality slightly but keeps latency within SLOs. Documenting tradeoffs in incident ticket.
oliver: nice work. After-action items: 1) automated per-key surge quarantine 2) conservative default per-plan caps 3) more aggressive embedding-cache for lookup endpoints 4) analytics alert for batch-aggregator anomalies.
erin: current status: backlog 1.05x, errors 0.9%, keeping limits for 25 more minutes then incremental relax.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATED: INC-3302 active, severity lowered to SEV-2.
natasha: thanks team. closing slack thread for live mitigation; further discussion in postmortem.
